upperAdd_eq_add_of_ne_bot.statement: theorem upperAdd_eq_add_of_ne_bot (a b : EReal) (ha : a ≠ ⊥) (hb : b ≠ ⊥) : upperAdd a b = a + b

ereal_finset_sum_ne_bot.statement: theorem ereal_finset_sum_ne_bot {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → EReal) (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, a i ≠ ⊥) : (∑ i ∈ s, a i) ≠ ⊥

convex_finset_sum.statement: theorem convex_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E → EReal) (hb : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ y, f i y ≠ ⊥) (hc : ∀ i ∈ s, IsConvexExtended (f i)) : IsConvexExtended (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, f i y)

finite_sum_point.statement: theorem finite_sum_point {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (x : E) (hx : ∀ i, ∃ r : ℝ, f i x = (r : EReal)) : ∃ r : ℝ, (∑ i, f i x) = (r : EReal)

sum_finite_implies_components_finite.statement: theorem sum_finite_implies_components_finite {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → EReal) (hb : ∀ i, a i ≠ ⊥) (ht : (∑ i, a i) ≠ ⊤) : ∀ i, ∃ r : ℝ, a i = (r : EReal)

interior_domain_sum.statement: theorem interior_domain_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (hb : ∀ i y, f i y ≠ ⊥) (z : E) (hz : ∀ i, z ∈ interior (effectiveDomain (f i))) : z ∈ interior (effectiveDomain (fun y => ∑ i, f i y))

binary_subgradient_decomposition.statement: theorem binary_subgradient_decomposition (f h : E → EReal) (hpf : SourceProper f) (hph : SourceProper h) (hcf : IsConvexExtended f) (hch : IsConvexExtended h) (x : E) (hfx : ∃ a : ℝ, f x = (a : EReal)) (hhx : ∃ b : ℝ, h x = (b : EReal)) (g : E) (hgs : g ∈ SourceSubdifferential (fun y => f y + h y) x) (hqual : ∃ z : E, z ∈ interior (effectiveDomain f) ∧ z ∈ effectiveDomain h) : ∃ p : E, p ∈ SourceSubdifferential f x ∧ g - p ∈ SourceSubdifferential h x

theorem_2_23_inclusion.statement: theorem theorem_2_23_inclusion {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → E → EReal) (hp : ∀ i, SourceProper (f i)) (x : E) : SourceSubgradientSum f x ⊆ SourceSubdifferential (fun y => ∑ i, f i y) x

theorem_2_23_equality.statement: theorem theorem_2_23_equality (n : ℕ) (f : Fin (n + 1) → E → EReal) (hp : ∀ i, SourceProper (f i)) (hc : ∀ i, IsConvexExtended (f i)) (hclosed : ∀ i, SourceClosed (f i)) (hqual : ∃ z : E, z ∈ effectiveDomain (f (Fin.last n)) ∧ ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), i ≠ Fin.last n → z ∈ interior (effectiveDomain (f i))) (x : E) : SourceSubdifferential (fun y => ∑ i, f i y) x = SourceSubgradientSum f x
